name: Unplanned Trip: Limited Edition
overview: Several years after Jung Yu Mi, Park Seo Jun, and Choi Woo Shik became successful restauranters in another show, they've reunited to enjoy some time off of their normal jobs. The trio will travel all across South Korea, but there's a twist: they don't know exactly where they're going or how they're getting there, and they must travel to a new city every day. Loosely chaperoned by legendary television producer Na Yeong Seok, affectionately known as "Na PD," these actors are in for a journey they'll never forget as they're forced to make tough, yet entertaining choices along the way.
